applicationInfo.name: Banking App Terraform Demo
applicationInfo.description:
### Summary
AWS-based banking application infrastructure for threat modeling demonstrations. Provides customer account access and admin operations through API Gateway, Lambda, and RDS PostgreSQL.

### Key objectives
- Demonstrate banking application infrastructure patterns
- Enable threat modeling training and AI tool testing
- Showcase AWS serverless architecture with security considerations
- Provide realistic financial services use case scenarios

### Use-cases
- Customer account information retrieval
- Transaction history viewing
- Administrative account management (freeze/unfreeze)
- User authentication and authorization
- Secure data storage and access

### Features
- RESTful API via Amazon API Gateway HTTP API
- Serverless compute with AWS Lambda (Python 3.11)
- PostgreSQL database on Amazon RDS
- User authentication via Amazon Cognito User Pool
- Encryption capabilities with AWS KMS
- Centralized logging with CloudWatch Logs
- VPC networking with public subnets
